imageDecision.decision: ColorMap and NormalMap reuse the images the Open Cloud importer uploaded implicitly from each GLB (52 files), each checked by pixel readback against its PNG. RoughnessMap and MetalnessMap use the 25 grayscale PNGs from uploadTextures (19 roughness + 6 metalness), uploaded once each as Image assets. Importer roughness/metalness images are never referenced. Files embedded in two GLBs (GR_Shrubs_*, BR_Wood/Kit/Stone/Log_*) keep the id from their first import (GroundReal_Flora, BuildingsReal). If an importer image fails the readback check, that PNG is uploaded instead (once).
evidence: Every embedded Color and Normal image in the 8 GLBs is byte-identical (sha256) to its upload PNG; no roughness or metalness PNG is embedded (the GLBs carry packed MR/ORM copies instead).

GroundReal_Flora import: 16/16 MeshParts, each with an importer SurfaceAppearance; GR_Plants images Color 140424583898788, Normal 81507085904195, Roughness 86627699425187, Metalness 123004125232832 (shared with GR_Shrubs); GR_Shrubs Color 90259594919684, Normal 88236644004111, Roughness 71789053819131. All are Image assets owned by user 5458010221, displayName image, Approved, created 01:22:59Z just before the model revision.

EditableImage readback, GR_Plants: Color 1024x1024, the same 5 sample pixels as the PNG (including colour in transparent texels), alpha<128 on 63.2% vs 63.3%; Normal 1024x1024, the same 5 sample pixels (G not flipped); Roughness 512x512 (the PNG is 1024x1024); Metalness 512x512 flat 0.

Packed MR vs authored maps (means equal): half resolution for GR_Plants/GR_Shrubs (512 vs 1024) and all LandmarksReal sheets (256 vs 512); BuildingsReal non-metal sheets have B mean 1/255 (would give non-empty metalness where the manifest says null); non-metal sets get an extra flat-black metalness image.
The importer leaves AlphaMode Overlay on the MASK card materials: cards render as grey boxes until AlphaMode = Transparency (screen capture).
imageDecision.result: 52 importer Color/Normal images verified pixel-exact (one id per file; the importer de-duplicated GR_Shrubs_* and BR_Log/Wood/Kit/Stone_* across GLBs); 25 grayscale PNGs uploaded once each and verified. 77 of 77 upload images covered.

importerUnused.note: Images the Open Cloud importer created implicitly from the GLBs that no template references: roughness and metalness derived from the packed glTF metallicRoughness/ORM maps, and one ColorMap baked from the PropsReal ember material (base colour + emissive). Approved assets on the account. RealAssets uses the uploaded grayscale PNGs for roughness/metalness and builds embers as Neon parts without a SurfaceAppearance.

duplicateUploadAudit.limit: The search tool returns at most 20 results per query and has no paging, and Open Cloud cannot list Image assets, so the 61 lower-id importer images cannot be listed account-wide. An unreferenced importer-made copy there is ruled out indirectly: one import per GLB (model inventory + transcript audit), and the importer reuses an existing id for identical content (GroundReal_Cliffs reused GroundReal_Flora's GR_Shrubs ids; PropsReal reused BuildingsReal's BR_* ids).
